question: Is Erling Haaland more valuable to Manchester City than Kylian Mbappe is to Real Madrid?

on_off_splits.delta_summary: Team produces 0.83 more PPG with Haaland on; xG drops 32% without.

scout_notes.author: Tifo Football
scout_notes.summary: Pure goal threat anchors City's penalty-area structure; replacement requires deep tactical rethink.

on_off_splits.delta_summary: Team produces 0.15 more PPG with Mbappe on; xG marginally higher with.

scout_notes.author: The Athletic
scout_notes.summary: Star quality but Madrid's chance-creation machine produces irrespective of any single attacker.

dossier.context_notes: City's structure is more dependent on a single load-bearing striker; Madrid's depth and chance creation are diffuse.
